description:
The store. what: 'shelf' (default), 'title' (slug), 'ticket' (slug;
    copies held with `wallet`), 'buy' (slug, wallet: the copy's unsigned
    calldata; your wallet signs and sends), 'entitle' (slug, wallet: the text
    to sign; with `signature`, the download grant), 'items' (wallet; `slug`
    narrows), 'reviews'
    (slug), 'achievements' (slug or `wallet`; each badge names its evidence
    kind; `earned: null` = could not check), 'log' (curation acts), 'desk'
    (what `wallet` may edit), 'prepare' (slug: a keeper's dry run; `fields`
    to save), 'live' (slug: who is playing; unknown is null), 'leaderboard'
    (slug). Our games are placed by hand, not for sale; community games show
    first listed first until discovery is built. Nobody can pay for a slot. No number on a
    card is money: prices are eth_calls via wire. Nothing here holds a key.
name: store
